import polars as pl
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/hr/compensation")

async def evaluate_compensation_bands(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    content = await file.read()
    uploaded_df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content))

    if not {"role_family", "grade_level"}.issubset(uploaded_df.columns):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Missing role_family or grade_level")

    evaluated_df = (
        uploaded_df.lazy()
        .join(payroll_lazy, on=["role_family", "grade_level"], how="inner")
        .select(["role_family", "grade_level", "base_salary", "equity_grant_usd", "bonus_percentage"])
        .collect()
    )

    return {"count": len(evaluated_df), "benchmarks": evaluated_df.to_dicts()}

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException, status
import polars as pl
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/hr/compensation")

@router.post("/evaluate-bands")
async def evaluate_compensation_bands(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    content = await file.read()
    uploaded_df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content))

    if not {"role_family", "grade_level"}.issubset(uploaded_df.columns):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Missing role_family or grade_level")

    # Enforce company_id filter in lazy pipeline
    payroll_lazy = pl.scan_parquet("/data/hr/internal_payroll_master.parquet").filter(
        pl.col("company_id") == current_user.company_id
    )
    evaluated_df = (
        uploaded_df.lazy()
        .join(payroll_lazy, on=["role_family", "grade_level"], how="inner")
        .select(["role_family", "grade_level", "base_salary", "equity_grant_usd", "bonus_percentage"])
        .collect()
    )

    return {"count": len(evaluated_df), "benchmarks": evaluated_df.to_dicts()}
